1 جَنَزَهُ , aor.
جَنِزَ , (A, Msb, K,) and
جَنُزَ , (A,) inf. n. جَنْزٌ, (TA,) He veiled, concealed, hid, or covered, it. (A, Msb, K.) ＝
-A2- He collected it; or gathered it together or up; (K;) as also ↓ جنّزِهُ , inf. n. تَجْنِيزٌ. (Sgh, TA.) You say also, جُنَزَ الرَّجُلُ, part. n. ↓ مَجْنُوزٌ , The man was gathered up [app. as a corpse is gathered up in the grave-clothes]: (TA:) or (assumed tropical:) he died. (Har p. 122.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
